title: Minecraft BEST SAND DUPER 1.20.2 - NEW - 72000+ PER HOUR!
description:
Hello Everybody TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft video, In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Efficient Sand Duper In Minecraft 1.20.2

📚This sand is so simple and easy also you can build this farm in 30 - 40mins!
📚You can use gravel, sand, and concrete powders on this duper
📚Unfortunately due to game mechanics, this duper doesn't work on the bedrock edition
📚The chunk-loader needs to be in the same chunk as the on-switch of the duper
📚For the purpose of the collection I found having multiple rows of hoppers going into multiple chests works better than the single line; i.e. upon breaking upon the buttons, the sand blocks can also land on adjacent squares, and splitting it like that keeps it from stalling.
📚Make sure to watch the video carefully this duper is simple but you have to build the duper carefully
